prompt: Predict the product of benzylic bromination of toluene with NBS and a radical initiator.

traps.note: NBS/radical conditions do benzylic (not ring) bromination.

explanation: NBS supplies a low concentration of Br₂ and generates benzylic radicals (stabilized by the ring); H on the benzylic CH₃ is abstracted, Br⁻ captures the radical.
